Remark
[failure of a $C^{1,\gamma }$ vector-field estimate]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-schauder-estimates 1. ch11:11.6.6Demonstrate that, unlike the elliptic estimates of subsection 2.2, it is not possible to find $C^{1,\gamma }$ bounds for a vector field $X$ in terms of $C^0$ bounds on $X$ and $\operatorname {div}X$.
